gloss: how something looks in a photo; quality of a photograph

definitions.gloss: how something appears in a photograph; photographic quality
definitions.explanation: The way a subject looks when captured in a photograph. Refers to whether someone or something looks good or bad in pictures.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{実物|じつぶつ}→実物：04215_jitsubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: She just doesn't photograph well — she looks much prettier in person.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: This camera has a good lens, so the photo quality is completely different.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧ (to be photographed). Commonly used to discuss how flattering or unflattering photos are. Very common in everyday conversation about photography and selfies.

FORMS:
Noun form of ⟦{写|うつ}る→写る：11494_utsuru⟧ (to be photographed, to appear in a photo).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to look good in photos; to photograph well
- {写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to look bad in photos; not photogenic
- {写|うつ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧: to worry about how one looks in photos

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{映|うつ}り→映り：24196_utsuri⟧: how something looks on screen (TV, video) — different kanji for video/screen contexts
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{写|うつ}り: specifically how one looks in photographs

USAGE:
The expression {写|うつ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/わるい is one of the most common ways to talk about being photogenic or not in Japanese.
